# Hollands Vastgoedfonds

> Hollands Vastgoedfonds is an independent Dutch real estate investor that buys property directly and for its own account: homes, let residential portfolios, offices, shops, mixed-use buildings, business units, light-industrial and logistics property, and buildings with redevelopment potential. It is not an estate agent. Sellers pay no commission, there is no bank financing condition, and let property is bought with the tenants in place. The website is Dutch first, with English at /en/.

## Sell your property
- [Vastgoed aanbieden (offer your property)](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/vastgoed-aanbieden/): three-step form, free of obligation
- [Wat wij kopen (what we buy)](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/wat-wij-kopen/)
- [Woningen en portefeuilles](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/wat-wij-kopen/woningen/)
- [Commercieel vastgoed](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/wat-wij-kopen/commercieel-vastgoed/)
- [Bedrijfsvastgoed en logistiek](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/wat-wij-kopen/bedrijfsvastgoed/)
- [Bijzondere situaties](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/wat-wij-kopen/bijzondere-situaties/)

## How it works
- [Werkwijze (approach)](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/werkwijze/): regional capital allocation, in-house due diligence, completion through a notary
- [Veelgestelde vragen (FAQ)](https://hollandsvastgoedfonds.com/veelgestelde-vragen/)
